blocks.text: QUEZON CITY, Philippines — Miriam College and the Inquirer Foundation signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) on Sept. 29, 2026, establishing a strategic partnership aimed at expanding student internships, faculty and professional development, and community extension programs. ​The agreement was signed by Ms. Connie Kalagayan, Executive Director of the Inquirer Foundation, and Dr. Marilu Madrunio, Dean of the Miriam College Higher Education Unit. Ms. Ching Garcia, HR and Admin Director of Inquirer Interactive, and Ms. Mae Ann Chua, Area Chair of Creative Communications and Design at Miriam College, served as witness signatories. ​While best known as the corporate social responsibility arm […]...
